caption: The drawing features a single horizontal decorative band positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The band itself consists of three main color sections: the uppermost and lowermost edges are bordered with thin, solid black lines, inside of which are medium-width gray stripes. The central portion of the band is a wide blue strip, outlined in black, with a repeating pattern of black oval shapes evenly spaced along its length. Interwoven through the blue strip is a continuous white geometric line, looping around each black oval in a symmetrical pattern, creating a series of connected loops. The rest of the background remains unembellished and neutral, highlighting the central band.
title: Wallpaper Border
